values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/gooselake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Goose Lake State Forest Campground: 30 campsites, $20, managed by Mitchell SP, phone 231-775-7911), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Boat launch on Goose Lake.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/gooselake ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.' 'There is a boat launch on Goose Lake.'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/gooselake ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Goose Lake State Forest Campground: 30 campsites, $20, managed by Mitchell SP, phone 231-775-7911: Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 30 'tent and small trailer sites' (DNR wording, no length limit posted). One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/gooselake ('this rustic campground offers 30 tent and small trailer sites') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (30 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground on the Goose Lake shoreline in mixed evergreen and hardwood forest, 2.5 mi NW of Lake City via M-42, Randall Road, Goose Lake Road and Green Road (Missaukee County); managed by Mitchell State Park. Paved boat launch. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 30 tent/small-trailer sites, $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day maximum (inherited max now confirmed). Season (open all year) already manual. Note trimmed of field restatements.
